topic: Freeman's upper-limsup m-palindromic density and Fibonacci equality
title: Sharp upper-limsup density in Freeman's conjecture and an extension of the de Luca–Fischler Fibonacci formula

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: For Freeman's Conjecture 7.1 (arXiv:1604.06755v2, 25 January 2017, p. 10; density in section 6, p. 8), we prove the sharp upper-limsup replacement bound 1 and extend the Fibonacci-prefix formula of de Luca, as recalled by Fischler (2006, section 1), to establish the separate Fibonacci equality for all positive integers m,r,s with r distinct from s. The density-one examples have bounded partial quotients and are not eventually periodic: increasing powers of whole prefixes force local length ratios to approach one. A block-code identity gives all qualifying Fibonacci prefixes, including the cases with a terminal digit 1 and with m=1. The upper-limsup density differs from the classical lower-liminf density.
summary: The sharp upper-limsup bound is 1 for every positive m. The full Fibonacci equality is proved for every positive m,r,s with r distinct from s. The same construction corrects the upper-limsup bound in Abdullah–Hamoud, Lemma 4.3.
posing_locator: Conjecture 7.1, p. 10; density definition in section 6, p. 8; Fibonacci lower bound in section 7, p. 9

written_proofs: Attained sharp upper-limsup density 1 for every positive m,r,s with r distinct from s
Block-code classification for all positive letters, including odd prefixes and terminal digit 1
Transport of both upper-limsup and lower-liminf prefix densities
Full Fibonacci equality for every positive m,r,s with r distinct from s, using the cited classical prefix formula
Conditions (*)_w and (*)_hat(w) for every w>1, and (**)_(w,w') for every w>1 and w'>0 with nonempty initial words; the endpoint w'=0 holds under the empty-initial-word convention
Counterexample and sharp replacement for Abdullah–Hamoud Lemma 4.3's right-hand upper-limsup bound
coverage.lean_statement: Negation of the universal upper-limsup bound using the (m,r,s)=(2,2,3) witness
coverage.finite_checks: Exact prefix enumeration, block-code classification, rational comparisons and root-growth comparisons; ranges and totals in README.md and checker-output.json
prior_results: Classical Fibonacci-prefix formula attributed to de Luca (1997, Theorem 5) by Fischler (2006, section 1)
Fischler's classical extremal bound for the reciprocal forward limsup
Freeman's Fibonacci lower bound and transcendence criterion
not_covered: A maximal lower-liminf bound for m greater than 1
Freeman's nonstammering examples and quadratic conjugacy classification

related_locator: Lemma 4.3, equation (7), pp. 7–8; introductory equation (1) uses a different density convention
